decisions.reason: As a newly launched dietary supplement range with its own product page, it likely has strategic relevance and would usually be given more time before discontinuation.
The product was actively introduced as a new pharmacy offering and, as a consumer-facing beauty supplement, is likely to be retained while the firm builds awareness and sales.
Although newly launched, the joint-health supplement appears less prominently positioned than A and B, so it faces some portfolio risk but would still normally be kept for another year.

A mushroom-based immune supplement is more niche and only briefly mentioned, which raises the chance of discontinuation, but a large firm would still often keep it on the market initially to test demand.
The explicit 2018 problem notice around Valsartan indicates a serious regulatory and supply issue, making withdrawal within the next year more likely than continued marketing.
